blocks.text: d-orbitals ki shakal clover ke patte (cloverleaf) jaisi hai: aam tor par ek plane mein chaar lobes ya do dumbbells. Paanch alag d orbitals hain: dxy, dxz, dyz, dx²−y² aur dz². Akele (isolated) atom mein paanchon ki energy barabar hoti hai (degenerate), lekin complex ion mein in ki alag shakalon ki wajah se energy alag ho jati hai (non-degenerate). In ka space mein arrangement (tarteeb) aur energy levels transition metals ki bonding, rang aur magnetic properties tay karte hain. Jab ligands octahedral ya tetrahedral complex banane ke liye metal ion ke qareeb aate hain to un ka electric field paanch d orbitals ko alag alag energy ke do groups mein baant (split) deta hai. Dono sets ke darmiyan energy ka farq splitting ka extent (miqdar) batata hai aur Δ se likha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch 3d orbitals apne axes ke saath: dxy, dyz aur dxz ke chaar lobes axes ke darmiyan; dx2-y2 ke chaar lobes x aur y axes par; dz2 ke do lobes z axis par aur beech mein aik challa (ring). Do rang lobes ke alag alag sign dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Paanch 3d orbitals ki shakalein (is topic ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Narangi aur neela rang wave function ke positive aur negative sign (phase) hain. dxy, dyz aur dxz ke lobes axes ke beech mein, jab ke dx²−y² ke lobes seedhe axes par hain; isi liye octahedral complex mein ligands (jo axes par aate hain) dx²−y² aur dz² ko zyada dhakelte hain aur yeh upar chale jate hain.

blocks.title: Degenerate aur non-degenerate orbitals
blocks.text: Degenerate orbitals ki energy barabar hoti hai. Ligands ke electric field se d orbitals do alag alag energy wale sets mein bat jate hain; ab yeh non-degenerate hain aur in ka farq Δ (ΔE) hai.
Octahedral complexes (chhe ligands) mein, jaise [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺, paanch d orbitals do sets mein bat jate hain: teen kam energy wale (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do zyada energy wale (dx²−y², dz²) (Figure 18.4).

blocks.alt: Energy diagram, Energy ka teer oopar. Degenerate Orbitals: paanch barabar dabbe dxy, dyz, dzx, dx2-y2, dz2, aik electron ke saath. Ligands interaction: paanchon dabbe oopar uthe hue. Phir splitting (batwara): dx2-y2 aur dz2 oopar, dxy, dyz aur dzx neeche electron ke saath, darmiyan Delta E. Light absorb hoti hai aur Excitation ke baad electron oopar wale set mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.4: Octahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (kitab ki Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺ jaisa d¹ ion hai, jis ka sirf ek d electron hai. Ligands ke aane se paanchon orbitals ki energy barhti hai, phir woh do sets mein bat jate hain: teen neeche aur do upar. Light ka ek hissa absorb ho kar electron ko neeche se upar bhejta hai; absorb hui light ki energy ΔE = hν ke barabar hai.

Tetrahedral complexes (chaar ligands) mein, jaise [CuCl₄]²⁻, splitting ulat jati hai: teen zyada energy wale orbitals (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do kam energy wale (dx²−y², dz²). Tetrahedral complexes mein splitting ka magnitude (miqdar) octahedral se kam hoti hai (Figure 18.5).

blocks.alt: Nau d electrons ka energy diagram. Degenerate orbitals: paanch barabar dabbe, chaar mein jore aur aik mein akela electron. Ligands interaction: dabbe oopar uthe hue. Splitting: dxy, dyz, dzx oopar (jora, jora, akela) aur dx2-y2, dz2 neeche (dono jore), darmiyan Delta E. Light absorb hoti hai aur Excitation ke baad oopar ka set poora aur neeche aik akela electron.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.5: Tetrahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (kitab ki Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh [CuCl₄]²⁻ jaisa d⁹ ion hai. Tetrahedral mein order ulat jata hai: do orbitals neeche aur teen upar, aur ΔE octahedral se chhota hota hai. Light neeche wale set ka ek electron upar ke us orbital mein bhejti hai jahan jagah khaali hai.

blocks.prompt: Octahedral complex mein kaun se d orbitals zyada energy par hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: dx²−y² aur dz², kyun ke in ke lobes axes par aane wale ligands ki seedh mein hain aur sab se zyada dhakele jate hain.

items: Akele atom mein paanch d orbitals degenerate; ligands inhein Δ ke farq se do sets mein baant'te hain.
Octahedral: 3 neeche, 2 upar. Tetrahedral: 2 neeche, 3 upar, aur splitting kam.
